name: Lyre
source:
A human ambassador awakens in the northern Kingdom of Lyre, his entourage gone as he's surrounded by strangers. His memory seems to be intact, but something is amiss... Figuring out their motives proves to be the easiest of the challenges thrown his way.

Entangled in a game of deception, a loyal Knight may be the only one he can trust. Help from a mysterious individual will find him as well, but will it be enough?

The secrets of Lyre and the mystery of their world as they know it start to unravel once more, as a terrible plot and an unlikely romance unfolds.

[From [url=https://atmac.itch.io/lyre]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位人类大使在北方的莱尔王国醒来，随行人员已不见踪影，身边尽是陌生人。他的记忆似乎完好无损，却总有什么不对劲……而在接踵而来的考验中，弄清他们的动机竟已算是最简单的一关。

卷入尔虞我诈的博弈后，一名忠诚的骑士或许成了他唯一能够信任的人。一位神秘人物也会伸出援手，可这真的足够吗？

随着可怕的阴谋与出人意料的恋情展开，莱尔的秘密，以及他们所认知的这个世界的谜团，将再一次逐渐揭晓。

[译自[url=https://atmac.itch.io/lyre]Itch.io[/url]]
